outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fractions) presented as mean ± SD (N=4) with error bars only; no individual data points (dots/circles) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across purification methods; it contains no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay); it contains no averaged-data plot, so the check does not apply.
